name: Immich
description: Photos from a self-hosted Immich server: random, from one album or person, favorites, or today's memories.

fields.name: mode
fields.label: Mode
fields.hint: random picks from the whole library.

fields.name: albumId
fields.label: Album ID
fields.hint: The UUID in the album's URL.

fields.name: personId
fields.label: Person ID
fields.hint: Optional: only this person's photos (the UUID in their URL).

fields.name: metadataStateKey
fields.label: Metadata state key
fields.hint: Stores {source, id, originalFileName, camera EXIF fields, people} under this key.

fields.name: saveAssets
fields.label: Save asset
fields.hint: Saves the photo to the frame's assets folder. auto follows the frame's setting. ESP32 frames never save.

fields.name: previewSize
fields.label: Image size
fields.hint: preview is resized by Immich and much lighter on memory; fullsize downloads the original.
